model: Original S042 time-quadratic normalized density on the genuine 2+1 open Lorentz diamond; theta in [0,1/2]
order: primary n then theta then replicate; withheld n then theta then replicate; cost n then theta
seed_suffix: phase_id (primary=0, withheld=1, cost=2), theta numerator, theta denominator, n, replicate
proposal_limit: 8*n+4096; final batch clipped to the remaining budget
sampler: Each batch draws shape (batch,5) uniforms. Flat t=sign(u0-1/2)*(1-cbrt(1-u1)); r=(1-|t|)*sqrt(u2); angle=2*pi*u3. Accept when u4*(1+9*theta/10) <= 1+theta*(t*t-1/10). Round all coordinates to grid 2^24, reject rounded points outside the open diamond, retain first n accepted points.
precision_boundary: A stored finite-grid numerical approximation, not an exact continuous iid sampler. Empirical results do not prove coverage under this grid law or for physical observations.
observation: Estimator gets only (n,R), where R counts all comparable unordered pairs = all strict directed relations, including transitive ones. Exact int64 chronology on the stored grid. No coordinates, parameter, seed or anchors reach estimate().
certificate: Exact rational b with floor(n/2)*b^2 >= 2*(369/100)*(v+b/3); 48-step monotone inverse bracket; add (3/20)*half-bracket-width. Choose inverse only if its conservative radius <=3/80, otherwise midpoint. exp(369/100)>40 is checked by 21 positive series terms.
comparators: clipped inverse point estimate and its conservative radius
metrics: (3/20)*absolute parameter error: certified geometric upper bound, not actual geometric distance
frequency this upper bound fits reported radius
95% exact-binomial intervals for that repeated numerical event, per stratum
mean U versus exact continuous pair law, replicate-level standard error
sampling, complete all-pairs construction/count and reporting seconds
whole worker wall time, lifetime peak RSS and job commit
saved coordinate bytes and hypothetical dense one-bit relation storage
correctness_gate: All rational report checks; full scalar count oracle at n=128; first 64 points scalar-versus-block for every other case; full independent time-sorted integer count during audit for every cost case; all coordinate guards, hashes and resource records; no missed or duplicated planned cases on completed execution.
replication_gate: Replay each seed to exactly reproduce stored coordinates in the recorded environment; compare independently computed count, report inequalities and evaluation errors. Cross-platform random-stream identity is not promised.
point_diagnostic_gate: Raw inverse MAE at least 10% below midpoint MAE at both withheld n=2048 strata. This is a diagnostic threshold, not a selected-policy or coverage claim.
cost_gate: All three n=74606 cost cases complete within limits and conservative policy radius <=1/40. This establishes bounded computation feasibility only; one replicate per parameter cannot validate empirical coverage.
coverage_precision: 32 independent numerical replications per small stratum; report broad exact 95% binomial intervals, never present observed coverage as a proof of the theorem. Cost cells have one repetition and are excluded from Monte Carlo coverage conclusions.
stopping: No evaluation tuning or retries. Stop subsequent workers after first correctness/resource failure or total budget exhaustion. Keep partial samples, stdout and resource outcomes. Artifact budget checked after each worker; within-worker maximum planned coordinate/output volume is below that budget. Audit separately bounded; incomplete audit is not a pass.
source_freeze: Commit and push all execution and audit code plus protocol before sampling. Require clean worktree, local HEAD matching origin/main, per-file Git/raw-worktree hashes, immutable source snapshots and Python/NumPy/SciPy/platform identities.
decision: Reuse accepted S042 proof; separately judge 3+1 investment from actual utility, observation cost and new geometric obligations. Do not broaden the family or change n after observing data. Preserve earlier studies, proofs and DOI manuscripts. No physical, sharpness or full-class reconstruction claim.
